documented_limitations.behavior: Model inference is suppressed and data_quality.sufficient_data is flagged False. Prevents spurious false positives on new accounts.
documented_limitations.mitigation: Fallback to deterministic analytics until minimum 10 transactions accumulated.

documented_limitations.behavior: Users with only 1 month of history cannot compute month-over-month trends (OLS trend returns None).
documented_limitations.mitigation: Requires >= 2 distinct months for linear trend regression.

documented_limitations.behavior: A massive legitimate one-off bonus (e.g. ₹500,000) creates income volatility and high largest_transaction_ratio, which can score as an anomaly.
documented_limitations.mitigation: Structured output explains contributing feature is income-driven rather than an alarming spending deficit.

documented_limitations.behavior: Unsupervised Isolation Forest detects point/subspace outliers rather than slow secular 2% monthly lifestyle inflation across 12 months.
documented_limitations.mitigation: Detected by Phase 8 deterministic OLS trend analyzer (spending_trend slope > 0).
